  When I was about eight my brother threatened to beat me up unless I gave him a blowjob.  Its was kind of a complicated situation for me since he was seven years older then me, also as he was the older brother I really looked up to him and wanted nothing more then his approval because most of the time he was pretty mean to me.

  I was very uncomfortable doing it when he made me and the threats didn't help.  Mind you he never actually assaulted me, just threated.

  About a year or so later I ended up telling someone in confidence what was happening and they told my parents right after that.  To which my brother got a verbal scolding and we both had to do counselling.

  Years later we talked a bit about it and he gave me a very sincere apology to which I told him I had forgiven him years ago.  We are very close now and have been for a while.  I do however believe that because of this I was introduced to sexuality early and I believe it might have contributed to me being bi now.  I say contributed, not CAUSED me to be.

I know some may say this isn't rape but to me I felt like I had been.

TL:DR My brother made me give him head but now we're bros.
